page.description: OPNsense editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: A FreeBSD-based firewall and routing platform with a web interface, released as a community edition twice a year, with a paid business edition on top.
pros: Web interface for firewalling, VPN, routing and reporting.
Twice-yearly image releases with frequent software point updates.
Community edition is free; the business edition is a subscription.
Hardened FreeBSD base with UEFI hybrid images.
cons: Images ship bzip2-compressed, so the download is larger than a plain ISO.
No end-of-life date is published for a series.
The installed software upgrades independently of the image version.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for OPNsense; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: OPNsense publishes bzip2-compressed ISO and disk images. The DVD ISO is for a disc or a virtual machine; the VGA, serial and nano .img files are written to a USB stick or storage card. Writing any of them to a disk erases it.

editions.name: DVD installer
editions.description: Hybrid installer ISO with the full package set, for a DVD or a virtual machine.
editions.usbNote: 471 MB bzip2-compressed ISO. Decompress it, then burn the ISO or attach it to a VM.

editions.name: VGA installer
editions.description: Disk image for a USB stick or disk, with VGA console output for a monitor.
editions.usbNote: 471 MB bzip2-compressed image. Write it to a stick; writing erases the whole device.

editions.name: Serial installer
editions.description: Disk image with serial-console output, for headless appliances.
editions.usbNote: 471 MB bzip2-compressed image. Write it to a stick; writing erases the whole device.

editions.name: Nano image
editions.description: Small disk image for embedded boards and storage cards.
editions.usbNote: 468 MB bzip2-compressed image. Write it to a stick or card; writing erases the whole device.
